component.name: Nautilus Image Resizer
component.summary: Resize and crop images from the GNOME Files right-click menu

description.p: Adds a Resize Image entry to the right-click menu in GNOME Files. Pick a size by percent, by dimensions, or by target file size, crop with aspect presets if needed, and save over the original or as a copy.
A live preview shows the result before you save, with an estimate of the output file size. Your photos are laid out like prints scattered on a table; tap any photo to bring it to the front.

screenshot.caption: Resize and crop from the Files right-click menu

description.p: Multi-image stacks, scattered photo preview, faster startup and output estimates, and keyboard and screen reader support.
First release: percent, dimensions and target-size resizing with crop presets.
